name: Kuyuru Incense
description: A serene, restrained store theme for a small Kyoto incense house that sells hand-rolled sticks and cones, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Wisteria-smoke pages, mist panels and fine rules, ink-plum text and dark bands, and one muted plum accent kept to small marks and active states; Hina Mincho for display and Red Hat Text for text. A centred wordmark between a menu split left and right (cart on the right with WooCommerce), and a home page that follows ONE stick through its forty minutes as a quiet chaptered timeline: 00:00 Lit, 05:00 First note, 20:00 Heart, 40:00 Ash, each with its minute mark, a photograph and the blends that fit it, joined by thin drifting smoke-curl hairlines (still for those who ask for less motion). Five scent families as product categories, a scent guide, how to burn, about, the journal and contact, and a footer with KUYURU set large over the house details and a small sitemap. The house address, hours and shipping note, the scent-notes legend and the shelf with its prices and badge live in three synced patterns, so each is edited once (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the shelf and orders go by email).
deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H2 + F1 + L12 are as planned (combination unused). The muted plum #7A6483 is 4.4:1 on the ground (below AA for small text), so it is kept to small marks, rules, nodes and the smoke hairlines; links and accent text use a deeper plum #614D69 (6.4:1), quiet text #5F5664 (5.9:1). A pale smoke #F5F3F6 panel colour was added. Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 in google/fonts (ofl/hinamincho, ofl/redhattext; no Reserved Font Name) and subset to Latin WOFF2.
